name: Scarlet (open-source AI video editor)
summary: Desktop video editor (macOS, Windows, Ubuntu preview) where you tell Claude Code or Codex, by voice or text, what to change and review the edit on a timeline; original footage stays intact. Strong on dialogue cutting for interviews, podcasts and talking heads: removes pauses, false starts and repeated takes. Exports MP4 or an OpenTimelineIO timeline for DaVinci Resolve.

access.price: $0 (AI edits use your existing Claude Code or Codex subscription)
access.notes: Early development; frequent releases. Agent features require a Claude Code or Codex account. Linux is an Ubuntu 24.04 x86-64 preview.

procedure: Download the installer for macOS (dmg) or Windows (exe/msi) from https://github.com/Forward-Future/scarlet/releases, or build from source with pnpm
Create a project and import video, audio or images
In Settings > General connect Claude Code or Codex, then ask for edits by text or voice (hold V)

verdict.why: Free MIT desktop editor from a known creator, installers downloadable today, useful agent-driven dialogue cutting with Resolve export. Early-stage and needs a paid Claude Code/Codex plan for AI edits.
